records.source: Most fields loaded from each well: 'all', or a number. The first fields in field-number order are kept, with every time point and Z plane of each. Fields beyond the cap are left out of thumbnails, the well and image views, measurements, normalization and comparisons. Default 1.
records.translation: 从每个孔加载的最多视野数：'all' 或一个数字。按视野编号顺序保留前若干个视野，每个视野的所有时间点和 Z 平面均保留。超出上限的视野不会出现在缩略图、孔视图和图像视图、测量、归一化以及比较中。默认值 1。

records.source: Most wells loaded from each plate: 'all', or a number. Each loaded plate is capped on its own, always with its first wells in plate order (A01, A02, ... B01, ...). Wells beyond the cap stay on the plate view marked as not loaded and are left out of thumbnails, the well and image views, measurements, normalization and comparisons. Changing it adds or drops only the wells concerned. Default 'all'.
records.translation: 从每块板加载的最多孔数：'all' 或一个数字。每块已加载的板单独设上限，始终按板上顺序保留前若干个孔（A01, A02, ... B01, ...）。超出上限的孔仍显示在板视图中并标记为未加载，但不会出现在缩略图、孔视图和图像视图、测量、归一化以及比较中。更改此值只会添加或移除相关的孔。默认值 'all'。

records.key: Add a page with the display settings
records.source: Add a page with the display settings

records.key: Add more plate folders, or folders of plates; several can be selected at once.
records.source: Add more plate folders, or folders of plates; several can be selected at once.
records.translation: 添加更多板文件夹或包含多块板的文件夹；可一次选择多个。

records.key: Add plate folders, or folders of plates, to this Overview.
records.source: Add plate folders, or folders of plates, to this Overview.
records.translation: 将板文件夹或包含多块板的文件夹添加到此概览。

records.key: Annotate wells, or define comparison groups, to choose by condition.
records.source: Annotate wells, or define comparison groups, to choose by condition.
records.translation: 标注孔或定义比较组，以便按实验条件选择。

records.key: Annotation values and comparison groups; tick one or more.
records.source: Annotation values and comparison groups; tick one or more.
records.translation: 标注值和比较组；勾选一个或多个。

records.key: Apply this layout to the remaining wells
records.source: Apply this layout to the remaining wells
records.translation: 将此布局应用于其余的孔

records.key: Channel names and display colours, filled from the acquisition metadata or the wavelengths. Edit a name or a colour (#rrggbb or a colour name) to override it. In the CMY and CMYK colour modes, cyan, magenta, yellow or black picks the ink a channel prints with.
records.source: Channel names and display colours, filled from the acquisition metadata or the wavelengths. Edit a name or a colour (#rrggbb or a colour name) to override it. In the CMY and CMYK colour modes, cyan, magenta, yellow or black picks the ink a channel prints with.
records.translation: 通道名称和显示颜色，根据采集元数据或波长填写。编辑名称或颜色（#rrggbb 或颜色名称）即可覆盖。在 CMY 和 CMYK 颜色模式下，青色、品红、黄色或黑色决定通道打印时使用的油墨。
通道 {channel} 的增强未应用：{error}

records.key: Choose wells from one or several plates: by condition, by ticking wells, or one well.
records.source: Choose wells from one or several plates: by condition, by ticking wells, or one well.
records.translation: 从一块或多块板中选择孔：按实验条件、勾选孔，或选择单个孔。

records.key: Choose where this well's images go on the page and what is printed around them.
records.source: Choose where this well's images go on the page and what is printed around them.
records.translation: 选择此孔的图像在页面上的位置，以及在其周围打印的内容。

records.key: Click a cell, or drag over several, to choose where this well's images go on the page.
records.source: Click a cell, or drag over several, to choose where this well's images go on the page.
records.translation: 单击一个格子或拖选多个格子，以选择此孔的图像在页面上的位置。

records.key: Column {column} is collapsed; double-click it or its strip to show it again.
records.source: Column {column} is collapsed; double-click it or its strip to show it again.
records.translation: 第 {column} 列已折叠；双击该列或其窄条即可重新显示。

records.key: Continue in the Custom export canvas with the wells placed so far.
records.source: Continue in the Custom export canvas with the wells placed so far.
records.translation: 带着目前已放置的孔，在自定义导出画布中继续。
显示设置已复制到 {count} 张图像。

records.key: Double-click to collapse column {column} and bring the other columns closer; right-click for more.
records.source: Double-click to collapse column {column} and bring the other columns closer; right-click for more.
records.translation: 双击可折叠第 {column} 列并使其他列靠拢；右键单击查看更多选项。

records.key: Double-click to collapse row {row} and bring the other rows closer; right-click for more.
records.source: Double-click to collapse row {row} and bring the other rows closer; right-click for more.
records.translation: 双击可折叠第 {row} 行并使其他行靠拢；右键单击查看更多选项。

records.key: Drag boxes to move them, drag around boxes to select several, and drop Overview images or image files here.
records.source: Drag boxes to move them, drag around boxes to select several, and drop Overview images or image files here.
records.translation: 拖动框可移动它们，在框周围拖动可选择多个框，也可将概览图像或图像文件拖放到此处。

records.key: Drag on the page to draw a text box.
records.source: Drag on the page to draw a text box.
records.translation: 在页面上拖动以绘制文本框。

records.key: Drag to move; drag the lower-right corner to resize.
records.source: Drag to move; drag the lower-right corner to resize.
records.translation: 拖动可移动；拖动右下角可调整大小。

records.key: Draw a scale bar on every image.
records.source: Draw a scale bar on every image.
records.translation: 在每张图像上绘制比例尺。

records.key: Draw a scale bar on the image; needs the pixel size.
records.source: Draw a scale bar on the image; needs the pixel size.
records.translation: 在图像上绘制比例尺；需要像素大小。

records.key: End the PDF with a page listing channels, normalization and colour mode.
records.source: End the PDF with a page listing channels, normalization and colour mode.
records.translation: 在 PDF 末尾添加一页，列出通道、归一化和颜色模式。

records.key: Export cancelled; no file was written.
records.source: Export cancelled; no file was written.
records.translation: 导出已取消；未写入任何文件。

records.key: Export every field, the first fields, or pick fields in each well.
records.source: Export every field, the first fields, or pick fields in each well.
records.translation: 导出所有视野、前几个视野，或在每个孔中挑选视野。

records.key: Export image-level measurements first to print them here.
records.source: Export image-level measurements first to print them here.
records.translation: 请先导出图像级测量，才能在此处打印它们。

records.key: Grid spacing in points (72 points per inch).
records.source: Grid spacing in points (72 points per inch).
records.translation: 网格间距，单位为磅（每英寸 72 磅）。

records.key: Guided export, Custom export or contact sheet PDFs, written to the results folder.
records.source: Guided export, Custom export or contact sheet PDFs, written to the results folder.
records.translation: 引导式导出、自定义导出或缩略图总览 PDFs，写入结果文件夹。

records.key: Guided export, Custom export or contact sheet PDFs.
records.source: Guided export, Custom export or contact sheet PDFs.
records.translation: 引导式导出、自定义导出或缩略图总览 PDFs。

records.key: Horizontal alignment of the text in its box.
records.source: Horizontal alignment of the text in its box.
records.translation: 文本在其框内的水平对齐方式。

records.key: How many fields of each well First fields takes.
records.source: How many fields of each well First fields takes.
records.translation: “前几个视野”从每个孔中选取的视野数。

records.key: Image-level measurements to print, averaged over the well's chosen fields.
records.source: Image-level measurements to print, averaged over the well's chosen fields.
records.translation: 要打印的图像级测量值，按该孔所选视野取平均。

records.key: No images were found in {path} or in its immediate subfolders.
records.source: No images were found in {path} or in its immediate subfolders.
records.translation: 在 {path} 及其直接子文件夹中未找到图像。

records.key: Open a layout saved as JSON.
records.source: Open a layout saved as JSON.
records.translation: 打开以 JSON 保存的布局。

records.key: Pages of the PDF, in order; click one to edit it.
records.source: Pages of the PDF, in order; click one to edit it.
records.translation: PDF 的各页，按顺序排列；单击某页即可编辑。

records.key: Place every remaining well the same way, in the next free cells, with the same information around it.
records.source: Place every remaining well the same way, in the next free cells, with the same information around it.
records.translation: 以相同方式将其余每个孔放入接下来的空闲格子，并在其周围显示相同的信息。

records.key: Plates the wells are chosen from.
records.source: Plates the wells are chosen from.

records.key: Printed where Free text is placed.
records.source: Printed where Free text is placed.
records.translation: 打印在“自由文本”所放置的位置。
重做最近一次撤销的更改（Ctrl+Shift+Z）。

records.key: Remove the shown plate from this Overview; its files are not touched.
records.source: Remove the shown plate from this Overview; its files are not touched.
records.translation: 从此概览中移除当前显示的板；其文件不受影响。

records.key: Resize images without stretching them; turn off to stretch.
records.source: Resize images without stretching them; turn off to stretch.
records.translation: 调整图像大小时不拉伸；关闭则允许拉伸。

records.key: Restored {count} more source paths saved with this Overview.
records.source: Restored {count} more source paths saved with this Overview.
records.translation: 已恢复与此概览一同保存的另外 {count} 个源路径。

records.key: Return every channel of this image to the plate's display settings.
records.source: Return every channel of this image to the plate's display settings.
records.translation: 将此图像的每个通道恢复为该板的显示设置。

records.key: Return the selected channel to the global values.
records.source: Return the selected channel to the global values.
records.translation: 将所选通道恢复为全局值。

records.key: Row {row} is collapsed; double-click it or its strip to show it again.
records.source: Row {row} is collapsed; double-click it or its strip to show it again.
records.translation: 第 {row} 行已折叠；双击该行或其窄条即可重新显示。

records.key: Save this layout as JSON in the results folder, to reopen and edit later.
records.source: Save this layout as JSON in the results folder, to reopen and edit later.
records.translation: 将此布局以 JSON 保存到结果文件夹，以便之后重新打开和编辑。

records.key: Select fields or wells in the Overview first.
records.source: Select fields or wells in the Overview first.
records.translation: 请先在概览中选择视野或孔。
选择、移动框并调整其大小。

records.key: Show the grid on the page; it is never printed.
records.source: Show the grid on the page; it is never printed.
records.translation: 在页面上显示网格；网格从不打印。

records.key: Snap box edges to the grid.
records.source: Snap box edges to the grid.
records.translation: 将框的边缘贴靠到网格。
第 1 步（共 4 步）：选择孔
第 2 步（共 4 步）：选择视野
第 3 步（共 4 步）：第 {number} 个孔（共 {total} 个），{well}
第 4 步（共 4 步）：预览

records.key: Text of the selected text box.
records.source: Text of the selected text box.

records.key: The PDF could not be written: {error}
records.source: The PDF could not be written: {error}

records.key: The image source is not loaded: {label}
records.source: The image source is not loaded: {label}

records.key: The pixel size of these images is not known, so no scale bar can be drawn.
records.source: The pixel size of these images is not known, so no scale bar can be drawn.
records.translation: 这些图像的像素大小未知，因此无法绘制比例尺。

records.key: The pixel size of this image is not known, so no scale bar can be drawn.
records.source: The pixel size of this image is not known, so no scale bar can be drawn.
records.translation: 此图像的像素大小未知，因此无法绘制比例尺。

records.key: The plates found in the source paths: a folder with images in it is a plate, otherwise each subfolder with images is one. Double-click a name to rename the plate.
records.source: The plates found in the source paths: a folder with images in it is a plate, otherwise each subfolder with images is one. Double-click a name to rename the plate.
records.translation: 在源路径中找到的板：直接包含图像的文件夹是一块板，否则每个包含图像的子文件夹各是一块板。双击名称可重命名该板。

records.key: This file is not a spaCR canvas layout.
records.source: This file is not a spaCR canvas layout.
records.translation: 此文件不是 spaCR 画布布局。

records.key: This folder holds images and also subfolders of images. Switch on to load each subfolder as a plate instead.
records.source: This folder holds images and also subfolders of images. Switch on to load each subfolder as a plate instead.
records.translation: 此文件夹既包含图像，也包含图像子文件夹。开启后会改为把每个子文件夹作为一块板加载。

records.key: This image has its own display settings; right-click it to change or reset them.
records.source: This image has its own display settings; right-click it to change or reset them.
records.translation: 此图像有自己的显示设置；右键单击可更改或重置。

records.key: Twelve fields per page from the export scope, with the display settings printed above them.
records.source: Twelve fields per page from the export scope, with the display settings printed above them.
records.translation: 每页来自导出范围的十二个视野，显示设置打印在其上方。

records.key: Wells to export, in this order.
records.source: Wells to export, in this order.

records.key: Where measurements are printed around this well's images.
records.source: Where measurements are printed around this well's images.
records.translation: 测量值在此孔图像周围的打印位置。

records.key: Where {item} is printed around this well's images.
records.source: Where {item} is printed around this well's images.
records.translation: {item} 在此孔图像周围的打印位置。

records.key: Write every page to one PDF: vector text, images at full resolution with the current display settings.
records.source: Write every page to one PDF: vector text, images at full resolution with the current display settings.
records.translation: 将所有页面写入一个 PDF：矢量文字，图像按当前显示设置以全分辨率输出。

records.key: Write the previewed pages to one PDF.
records.source: Write the previewed pages to one PDF.
records.translation: 将预览的页面写入一个 PDF。

records.key: {paths} holds images and subfolders of images; it is loaded as one plate unless Use subfolders is switched on.
records.source: {paths} holds images and subfolders of images; it is loaded as one plate unless Use subfolders is switched on.
records.translation: {paths} 包含图像和图像子文件夹；除非开启“使用子文件夹”，否则会作为一块板加载。

records.key: {well} is not loaded: it is beyond Overview max wells.
records.source: {well} is not loaded: it is beyond Overview max wells.
records.translation: {well} 未加载：它超出了“概览：最大孔数”。

records.key: Go back one step or one well.
records.source: Go back one step or one well.

records.key: Go on to the next step or well.
records.source: Go on to the next step or well.
records.translation: 前进到下一步或下一个孔。

records.key: Place this well on the next page.
records.source: Place this well on the next page.

records.key: Place this well on the previous page.
records.source: Place this well on the previous page.

records.translation: 显示下一块已加载的板。
显示上一块已加载的板。
